name: Acecarbromal
summary: Acecarbromal (INN), also known as acetylcarbromal and acetyladalin, is a hypnotic and sedative drug of the ureide (acylurea) group discovered by Bayer in 1917 that was formerly marketed in the United States and Europe. It is also used in combination with extract of quebracho and vitamin E as a treatment for erectile dysfunction under the brand name Afrodor in Europe.

uses.text: Acecarbromal (INN) (brand names Sedamyl, Abasin, Carbased, Paxarel, Sedacetyl, numerous others), also known as acetylcarbromal and acetyladalin, is a hypnotic and sedative drug of the ureide (acylurea) group discovered by Bayer in 1917 that was formerly marketed in the United States and Europe.

summaryZh: 醋卡溴脲是Bayer於西元1917年發現的，在美國及歐洲做為安眠藥及鎮靜劑之用。醋卡溴脲亦和白堅木的萃取物及維生素E組合用來治療勃起功能障礙，在歐洲以Afrodor此一商標販售。
summaryZhHans: 醋卡溴脲是Bayer于公元1917年发现的，在美国及欧洲做为安眠药及镇静剂之用。醋卡溴脲亦和白坚木的萃取物及维生素E组合用来治疗勃起功能障碍，在欧洲以Afrodor此一商标贩售。

pharmacology.en: Like other bromine-containing sedatives, it depresses activity in the central nervous system. Bromide released from it builds up slowly in the body.
pharmacology.zh: 和其他含溴的鎮靜劑一樣，它會抑制中樞神經系統的活動。由它釋出的溴離子會在體內緩慢累積。
pharmacology.zhHans: 和其他含溴的镇静剂一样，它会抑制中枢神经系统的活动。由它发布的溴离子会在体内缓慢累积。

sideEffects.en: It causes drowsiness and poor coordination. Because bromide builds up, long use can cause bromism, with confusion, slurred speech, rashes and psychosis. It is no longer marketed.
sideEffects.zh: 它會引起嗜睡與協調變差。由於溴離子會累積，長期使用可能造成溴中毒，出現意識混亂、口齒不清、皮疹與精神病。它已不再上市。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它会引起嗜睡与协调制差。由于溴离子会累积，长期使用可能造成溴中毒，出现意识混乱、口齿不清、皮疹与精神病。它已不再上市。

fact.en: Bayer discovered it in 1917. It contains bromine, and old sedatives of this kind caused a condition called bromism, a slow poisoning that was once a common cause of confusion in hospital patients.
fact.zh: 拜耳在1917年發現了它。它含有溴，而這類舊式鎮靜劑會造成名為「溴中毒」的慢性中毒；這在過去曾是住院病人意識混亂的常見原因。
fact.zhHans: 拜耳在1917年发现了它。它含有溴，而这类旧式镇静剂会造成名为「溴中毒」的慢性中毒；这在过去曾是住院病人意识混乱的常见原因。
